chunks: "Al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī عليه السلام was killed when Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام was four years old."

key_terms.أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ: Abū Jaʿfar, referring here to Imam Muḥammad al-Bāqir عليه السلام
key_terms.الْحُسَيْنُ: al-Ḥusayn, the grandson of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: How old was Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام when al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī عليه السلام was killed?
ai.summary: This report states that al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī عليه السلام was killed when Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام was four years old. It serves as a brief biographical and historical notice connecting the tragedy of Karbala to the early life of Imam al-Bāqir عليه السلام.
